newsitem.title: USA: Ecuador's Bucaram to succeed with reforms - Cavallo.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Bucaram to succeed with reforms - Cavallo.

text.p: Ecuador's President Abdala Bucaram should be able to successfully reform his country's economy, said a key government advisor on Wednesday.
Former Argentine Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo, architect of Argentina's economic stabiliization, said that Bucaram has all the preconditions for reform.

"I think Bucaram may be an extremely successful reformer of Ecuador," Cavallo told Reuters Financial Television. "I am confident that he will be able to assemble a good economic program for his government."

Cavallo said that, with his three-month commitment as advisor to Ecuador ending in several weeks, he would remain available for consultation but could not commit himself to spending as much time in Quito.
Cavallo also said that, despite Ecuador's problem of a large fiscal deficit, raising taxes did not seem sensible because the country already had high levels of tax evasion and smuggling.
